guitar.modelsText: Gretsch / session guitarists on early recordings
guitar.evidence: Mike Nesmith played Gretsch guitars, though much of The Monkees' early studio output (including 'I'm a Believer') used session musicians (the Wrecking Crew) rather than the band members.

tone.target: bright 60s pop-rock clean with tight strum
tone.profile: bright 60s pop-rock clean with tight strum
tone.summary: A classic 60s pop-rock sound achieved using a clean US Deluxe amp model, paired with a bright single-coil tone and minimal modulation/ambience for maximum clarity and punch.

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and background noise.
